_readme: EDIT THIS FILE to change any text in the app. Keep the quotes and commas. Keywords are lowercase words or short phrases; if a volunteer's question contains one, that answer can match. 'suggest': true shows the question as a tap button. All names, numbers and details are invented sample data.

event.name: Out on Bay Street
event.tagline: Your volunteer assistant. Pick your station to see what to do, who your lead is, and quick answers.

ui.askIntro: Ask a question or tap one below. Answers are pre-written by the volunteer team.
ui.askPlaceholder: e.g. Where do speakers check in?
ui.fallback: I'm not sure, message your lead.
ui.allStationsNote: Bookmark your station or scan the QR card at your table.
ui.footer: Concept demo by Team B, not an official Start Proud tool.

catchUp.title: Today's changes
lines: Doors open at 8:00 AM (15 min earlier than yesterday) — Registration staffed by 7:40.
Keynote moved from 9:30 to 10:00 AM in Victory Ballroom; speaker run-through at 9:15.
Career Fair booth 14 (Northlake Bank) swapped with booth 22 — updated maps are at the entrance.
Lunch is now in the 2nd-floor Foyer, not the Ballroom. Dietary tags are colour-coded.
Lost & found is now at Volunteer HQ only. Radio channel for all leads is Channel 4.

globalAnswers.question: Where are the washrooms?
globalAnswers.answer: All-gender washrooms are on every floor next to the elevators. Accessible washrooms are on floors 1 and 3 beside the stairwell.

globalAnswers.question: What's the Wi-Fi?
globalAnswers.answer: Network: OOBS-Guest · Password: ProudTogether26 (sample). Volunteers can use the same network.

globalAnswers.question: When is volunteer lunch?
globalAnswers.answer: Volunteer lunch is 11:30 AM–1:00 PM in the 2nd-floor Foyer. Check with your lead before stepping away so your station stays covered.

globalAnswers.question: Someone needs first aid. What do I do?
globalAnswers.answer: If it's life-threatening, call 911 first. Then radio Channel 4 or tell your lead. The first-aid kit and trained responder are at Volunteer HQ.

globalAnswers.question: Where is lost and found?
globalAnswers.answer: All lost items go to Volunteer HQ (2nd floor, Room 204). Log the item and where it was found on the clipboard by the door.

globalAnswers.question: Someone is being harassed or feels unsafe.
globalAnswers.answer: Stay calm, check in with the person, and don't confront the other party. Radio Channel 4 for a lead or hotel security. Every report is taken seriously under the Code of Conduct.

globalAnswers.question: Which radio channel do I use?
globalAnswers.answer: All leads are on Channel 4 today. Hotel security is on Channel 9 — only use it for emergencies.

globalAnswers.question: Where is the coat check?
globalAnswers.answer: Coat and bag check is on the ground floor, to the left of the main entrance. It's free for attendees.

stations.name: Registration
tasks: Greet attendees and ask for their name or the QR code in their confirmation email.
Scan the code (or search by last name) and hand over the badge and lanyard.
Point first-timers to coat check, then the Victory Ballroom on the 3rd floor.
Send media and speakers to the Speaker Green Room desk — don't badge them here.
Ask everyone if they'd like a pronoun pin. Never assume.

answers.question: Someone isn't on the list.
answers.answer: Try searching by email and by first name — chosen names may differ from the booking. Still nothing? Send them to the Help Desk at the end of the table; don't turn anyone away yourself.

answers.question: The badge printer jammed.
answers.answer: Use the backup printer under table 3. Hand-write a temporary badge from the blank stack if both are down, and radio your lead.

answers.question: Their name on the badge is wrong.
answers.answer: Reprint right away with the name they give you — no questions, no ID needed. Shred the old badge in the bin under the table.

answers.question: Where do speakers check in?
answers.answer: Speakers and media check in at the Speaker Green Room (3rd floor, Room 310). Walk them to the elevator and point the way.

stations.name: Career Fair
tasks: Help recruiters find their booth number using the floor map at the entrance.
Keep the aisles clear and the résumé-review line moving (10 minutes each).
Restock water and swag tables every hour.
Note booth 14 ↔ 22 swap today — update anyone using an old map.
At 3:15 PM give recruiters a 15-minute wrap-up heads-up.

answers.question: Where is a company's booth?
answers.answer: Check the large map at the entrance — booths run 1–30 clockwise from the door. Reminder: Northlake Bank moved to booth 22 today.

answers.question: A recruiter needs a power outlet.
answers.answer: Extension cords are in the grey bin behind the résumé-review table. Tape cords down across walkways with the gaffer tape in the bin.

answers.question: How does résumé review work?
answers.answer: Attendees add their name to the sign-up sheet; each session is 10 minutes. If the wait is over 30 minutes, offer them a slot after lunch.

stations.name: Victory Ballroom
tasks: Stand at your assigned door and help people find seats; keep the front row reserved for speakers.
Hold doors closed while a speaker is on stage — let latecomers in at applause.
Run a mic during Q&A: wait for the moderator to call on someone, then bring it over.
Keep the accessible seating area and aisles clear at all times.
Keynote starts at 10:00 AM today (moved from 9:30).

answers.question: When does the keynote start?
answers.answer: Keynote is at 10:00 AM today (moved from 9:30). Afternoon panels start at 1:30 PM. Full agenda is on the screen by the ballroom doors.

answers.question: The ballroom is full.
answers.answer: Direct people to the overflow livestream in Room 305 across the hall. Don't let people stand in the aisles — it's a fire-code issue.

answers.question: The mic or slides aren't working.
answers.answer: Signal the AV booth at the back (wave both arms) and radio Channel 4. Spare handheld mics are in the box at stage left.

answers.question: Someone needs accessible seating.
answers.answer: Accessible seating is front-left, near the ASL interpreter and the live-caption screen. Walk them over and remove the 'reserved' card if needed.

stations.name: Speaker Green Room
tasks: Check speakers in on the run-of-show sheet and give them a green badge.
Offer water, snacks and a quiet space. Keep the room calm — no attendees inside.
Collect slide files on the USB stick and hand them to AV by 30 minutes before the session.
Walk each speaker to the Victory Ballroom stage 10 minutes before their slot.
Keynote run-through is at 9:15 AM today.

answers.question: A speaker hasn't arrived.
answers.answer: Call the number on the run-of-show sheet at 30 minutes before their slot. At 15 minutes, radio Danielle so the moderator can adjust the order.

answers.question: A speaker wants to change their slides.
answers.answer: Copy the new file to the USB stick and walk it to the AV booth yourself. After the 30-minute cutoff, check with AV before promising anything.

answers.question: What snacks are available?
answers.answer: Water, coffee, tea and a snack tray (vegan and gluten-free options labelled). Ask hotel staff on extension 310 for refills.

stations.name: Volunteer HQ
tasks: Sign volunteers in and out on the shift sheet and hand out radios and T-shirts.
Cover breaks: send a floater to any station that radios for one.
Run lost & found — log every item with time and location.
Keep the first-aid kit stocked and know where the trained responder is.
Post updates to the 'Catch me up' list as the day changes.

answers.question: A volunteer didn't show up.
answers.answer: Check the shift sheet for floaters, send one over, and mark the original volunteer as absent. Let the station lead know on Channel 4.

answers.question: We're out of volunteer T-shirts.
answers.answer: Extra boxes are in the storage closet behind HQ (code 2204, sample). If a size is gone, give a volunteer lanyard instead.

answers.question: How do I sign out at end of shift?
answers.answer: Return your radio, sign the shift sheet with your out-time, and grab your thank-you card. Hours are emailed within a week.
